item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Mon 19:17): Tesla-Milliarden | Forum Mobilität | Prozess in Cottbus
item.description:
Originally published Mon 16 Nov 2026 19:17 IST.
Der US-E-Autobauer Tesla will drei Milliarden Euro in den weiteren Ausbau des Werks in Grünheide bei Berlin stecken. Außerdem: Forum Mobilität im ländlichen Raum; Amtsgericht Cottbus - Prozess gefährliche Körperverletzung; Algen-Zucht in der Saarow-Therme.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Mon 18:25): Crimea Kerch Bridge hit in a huge Ukrainian drone attack
item.description:
Originally published Mon 16 Nov 2026 18:25 IST.

The Russian defence ministry says a record number of drones were fired from Ukraine overnight and more than 1300 were brought down by its air defences. An oil refinery in the Krasnodar region was targeted and there was damage to the Kerch Bridge which links Russia to occupied Crimea. Western countries call on Israel to allow rapid humanitarian access to Gaza. The Indonesian president apologises to neighbouring countries for the thick haze caused by massive forest fires in his country. The director of the Shakespeare Institute threatens to resign if plans to move the centre from Stratford-upon-Avon to Birmingham go ahead. And could co-founder Jensen Huang make a swift return to the US technology giant, Nvidia? The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
